properties.description:
Exploration, language support and coloring, and the reviewed TypeScript text editor iteration are complete enough to proceed. The next PredicateComposer work follows the child tasks: an illustrated behavior reference from the query composer mock, human review, usage and predicate-signature inventory, human review including Graph editor additions, implementation discussion and replacement, review across usage sites, then UI refinement.

PredicateComposer belongs to RelationalUi. Consumer-specific signatures and context must be explicit. The mock complements the written behavior reference and is not a reference implementation.

Agent exposure is deferred to the related Input idea for later agent/AI tool work. The longer-term direction includes navigating to compiled code of the running application; the immediate PredicateComposer round does not settle the full compilation experience. Existing backlog items cover full-code editing and reusable saved functions.
properties.title: Rework the expression and query system and its composer UI
